question: In Spring 2024, could I have taken 15-210 (Thu/Sun/Tue 14:30–15:45) and 15-251 (Section 2: Tue/Thu/Sun 11:30–12:20) in the same semester without any schedule conflict?
expected_answer: No conflict — 15-210 meets Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday at 14:30–15:45, while 15-251 Section 2 meets the same three days (Tuesday, Thursday, Sunday) at 11:30–12:20. Although they share all three meeting days, the time windows (11:30–12:20 and 14:30–15:45) do not overlap. P-009 did in fact take both courses in Spring 2024, confirming there was no conflict.
reasoning_type: Shared days, non-overlapping times — no conflict verification
common_mistake: Seeing that both courses share all three days (Tue/Thu/Sun) and concluding they must conflict without comparing actual start/end times
